data.body:
[P1] Recheck completion when a cached item settles

When resuming a STARTED batch with item 0 checkpointed SUCCEEDED and item 1 awaiting a callback, a predicate that completes when item 0 is SUCCEEDED and item 1 is STARTED initially returns false: item 0 reports synchronously before the controller starts item 1. Starting item 1 makes the predicate true, but this guard skips the completion check when item 0 subsequently settles with the same status. `tryStartNext()` cannot resolve the batch, so it suspends awaiting the callback instead of completing, potentially until timeout. The base implementation evaluates the predicate at settlement and completes this case. Re-evaluate completion on settlement even when the outcome is unchanged, and add a composed regression for this resumed-batch scenario.
